blocks.html: Feeling a bit worn out, just cooped up in your home and overloaded with tasks you can’t seem to manage? Relax, Robinsons Place Manila might just give you the right breather! Just head to Robinsons Place Manila’s Frozen Weekends from June 20 until July 4 with a special launch happening on June 19 .

In partnership with Manila City Bureau’s Manila Restaurant Week, mall patrons can look forward to exciting chilled food and beverages such as ice creams, gelatos, frappes, popular coolers from Tiger Sugar and Coffee Bean, and frozen ready-to-cook meats. Restaurants like Max’s, SNR, Mesa, Gerry’s Grill, Cabalen, Manam, Ramen Nagi, Yellow Cab, Pancake House, Chowking and Bonchon are on board too, with their latest promo and store offerings.
Plus, Robinsons Place Manila has a sweet surprise on June 26-27 and July 3-4! With a minimum purchase of Php1,000, shoppers can avail of a free ice cream!
Robinsons Place Manila, recently certified with a safety seal, not only offers a safe and secure shopping experience, but a cool and savory gastronomic journey too!
